violations.text: -Pulled pork was observed held at 110 degrees Fahrenheit in smoked n smashed. -Chicken cutlets and pizza were observed held between 110-125 degrees Fahrenheit in the pizza station. Pulled pork was reheated to above 165 DF and placed back into steam table at the time of inspection. Pan was missing in the right side of steam table causing a drop in food temperature. Pan was placed back into unit. PIC elected to dispose of chicken cutlets and pizza. Hot-holding door was observed to be open, causing a drop in food temperatures. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Establishment is to continuously monitor the internal food temperatures of the hot food to ensure it is staying above 135 DF. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Chicken was observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit at ocho loco. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. It was determined that the bottom of the prep unit was not receiving proper airflow due to food items blocking vent. Establishment is to ensure that all food is able to keep an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Chicken was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026
Chicken wings were observed being held past the date of disposition. Chicken wings were voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution in the sanitizer bucket was in excess of 400 parts per million (ppm). A quaternary ammonia sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be applied at the strength as indicated on the manufacturers' label. Sanitizer bucket was emptied at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, chicken wings were placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Chicken wings were moved to sheet pans to finish cooling at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the dry storage area. All single service items must be stored off of the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026
The sanitizer dispenser at the smoked n smashed 3-bay sink was observed in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/11/2026
The prep unit at smoked n smashed was observed with a leak at the bottom of unit. Establishment is to fix leak. Per PIC, service has been called. New Violation. Correct By: 11/06/2026

The outside recycling dumpster is not covered due to no cover/door available. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. Establishment is to have dumpster replaced/get a new cover/door. New Violation. Correct By: 11/11/2026
